text:
Nina: quick proposal 1: introduce `x-route-hint` as a small structured hint (policy, priority). servers accept both old `x-route` and new header for a 4mo overlap. SDKs expose `route_hint` param. thoughts?

Omar: ok but limit schema to {policy,priority}. keep header length <200. need hashing parity tests.

Tess: SDK plan: nonbreaking. add `route_hint` arg, prefer it over headers, emit one-time deprecation warning when legacy seen. add env var RW_QUIET_ROUTE_WARN to silence in CI.

Ben: console/telemetry: will parse `x-route-hint` into fields and add MIG-720 for rollup rewrite. add migration tag `routehint_migrate=v1`.

release-bot: Canary scheduled: feature `route_hint_structured` -> us-west-2 on 2024-11-02T05:00:00Z. CI jobs: routing-hash-compat, header-length-smoke, perf-smoke.

Nina: rollout timeline: RFC+docs (Tess), server shim + feature flag (Omar), SDK patches (Tess), console migration (Ben), remove legacy after 4mo. post PR links here. :white_check_mark:
